message.content:
One natural pattern is the integer part of \(2/n\) for \(n=1,2,3,\dots\):

\[
\lfloor 2/1 \rfloor=2,\quad \lfloor 2/2 \rfloor=1,\quad \lfloor 2/3 \rfloor=0,\quad \lfloor 2/4 \rfloor=0,\ldots
\]

So the next term is also \(0\).
